cohort: 247,524 primiparous women in Sweden who gave birth to a singleton fetus with cephalic presentation at ≥34 weeks gestation between 2014 and 2020
finding: Women with GDM had significantly longer active labor durations and a decreased chance of vaginal delivery at any given time point compared to women without GDM, regardless of labor onset method.
mod_finding: This study found that women with gestational diabetes mellitus had a decreased chance of vaginal delivery and an increased risk of prolonged labor, regardless of whether labor was spontaneous or induced.
